name: cold14-k492
title: AtomScout's leaver-read K-triangle skeleton (R = 492 helpers) with PR604's chains ported stage by stage, ColdBeyond's v3 cold ends and the E1 pair, at a free dispatch (ck x7, jp8 x65) with an exact per-time-Hall owner map (exact-window MIP, RINS)
summary: Provider menu {ck, atm3, jp8} of K-triangle words (code/construct_k_triangle.py, data/TRI-SCHEDULE.json; R = 492). Each provider chain ports the stages of its 504-helper shadow chain (build.shadows) onto the K-triangle word (port_stage), regroups frames (frame_regroup), then hyperplane_end and cold_end with recipes re-derived on the ported words. Owner search: Stack492's copy of ColdOwner's recipe.py (paths changed) driving solve_h.py (helper ranges read from the word R; objective sum F(r) = r*(73/r)^b, b = 0.001635) on the K-triangle provider locals: (1) aggregate free-dispatch LP over the menu (crossover, tight 3) -> LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json (bound 523258.923555; the warm map has 504-helper roles, every call widening, so it seeds nothing); (2) dispatch = per-time argmax of the LP selections -> DISPATCH.json (ck x7, jp8 x65); (3) exact-window LP (crossover) at that dispatch over base + AGG patterns with weight >= 0.01 -> LP-PATTERNS-EX.json (523259.086472); (4) exact-window MIP, RINS around the EX vertex (slack 2/1), gap 1e-9, 1800 s: time limit, obj 523259.13881, bound 523259.086472, gap 1.0e-7; (5) mkplan.py --locals (Stack492's mkplan: widths over the word's R helpers) reproduces data/PLAN.json byte for byte from the solve output with the admitted locals of Stack492/runs/D1. The map is admitted by the package's verifier chain, not by the search.

dispatch.origin: at the free dispatch ck ×7, jp8 ×65 (per-time argmax of the aggregate free-dispatch hosting LP over the K-triangle words {ck, atm3, jp8}; atm3 is never selected)
dispatch.plan_rule: the window MIP's PLAN with the provider registry re-derived from the admitted provider locals (widths over the word's R helpers) and `profile`/`assignment_sha256` recomputed from the map (Stack492 mkplan.py)

owners.origin: an exact per-time-Hall exact-window MIP solution (RINS around the exact-window LP vertex; 1800 s time limit, relative gap 1.0e-7)
owners.warm_owners_origin: complex-571-cold14-b3's `data/OWNERS.json.gz` (504-helper roles; every call is widening for the 492-helper words, so it seeds nothing)

search.tool: Stack492 recipe.py (ColdOwner's, paths changed) -> solve_h.py (helper ranges from the word R)
search.dispatch_rule: per time t: argmax over providers of LP-PATTERNS-AGG selections[t]

lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json: aggregate free-dispatch LP relaxation over the K-triangle words {ck, atm3, jp8} (crossover, tight 3)
lp_inputs.DISPATCH.json: the dispatch {time: provider} = per-time argmax of the aggregate LP selections
lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-EX.json: exact-window LP relaxation (crossover) at that dispatch over the base patterns plus aggregate-LP patterns with weight >= 0.01
lp_inputs.WARM-PLAN.json: the PLAN matching WARM-OWNERS.json.gz (ColdBeyond O3free-rins2 = complex-571-cold14-b3 PLAN) (line endings normalized to LF)
lp_inputs.TEMPLATE-PLAN.json: the PLAN of ColdBeyond's working package (PR604's dispatch ck ×44, atm3 ×22, jp8 ×6), whose windows/order/registry template the nominator reuses
